text: The leaves show dark, water-soaked patches. There is white, fuzzy growth on the underside of the leaves. Some stems have brown marks near the leaves. This looks like late blight, a disease that spreads quickly in cool, wet weather. It can destroy the whole crop within a few days if it is not controlled. Remove and destroy the infected leaves today. Do not water the plants from above; water the soil instead. Leave space between plants so air can move. Use a copper-based fungicide at the rate written on the product label. Do not plant tomato or potato on this land next season. This is AI guidance and may be wrong. Confirm with an extension officer or vet before using chemicals or medicines.

Ganyayyakin suna da tabo masu duhu kamar an jika su da ruwa. Akwai wani farin abu mai laushi a ƙarƙashin ganyayyakin. Wasu daga cikin kara suna da alamomi masu launin ruwan ƙasa kusa da ganyayyakin. Wannan yana kama da cutar late blight, wata cuta da ke yaɗuwa da sauri lokacin sanyi da damina. Za ta iya lalata gonar gaba ɗaya cikin 'yan kwanaki idan ba a magance ta ba. Cire ganyayyakin da suka kamu kuma ku ƙone su yau. Kada ku zuba ruwa a kan shukar daga sama; ku zuba ruwan a ƙasa. Ku bar tazara tsakanin shuke-shuke don iska ta ratsa. Ku yi amfani da maganin feshi na copper bisa yawan da aka rubuta a jikin kwalin maganin. Kada ku shuka tumatir ko dankalin Turawa a wannan gona a shekara mai zuwa. Wannan shawara ce daga AI kuma tana iya yin kuskure. Ku tabbatar da jami'in faɗaɗa aikin gona ko likitan dabbobi kafin amfani da sinadarai ko magunguna.

Àwọn ewé náà ní àbàwọ́n dúdú tó dà bí ẹni pé omi ti rì wọ́n. Ohun funfun rírọ̀ kan wà ní abẹ́ àwọn ewé náà. Àwọn igi kan ní àmì àwọ̀ ilẹ̀ nítòsí àwọn ewé. Èyí jọ àrùn late blight, àrùn tí ń tàn kálẹ̀ kíákíá nígbà òtútù àti òjò. Ó lè ba gbogbo oko jẹ́ láàárín ọjọ́ díẹ̀ tí a kò bá ṣàkóso rẹ̀. Yọ àwọn ewé tó ti kó àrùn kúrò kí o sì sun wọ́n lónìí. Má ṣe bomi rin àwọn ohun ọ̀gbìn láti òkè; bomi rin ilẹ̀ dípò bẹ́ẹ̀. Fi àlàfo sílẹ̀ láàárín àwọn ohun ọ̀gbìn kí afẹ́fẹ́ lè máa kọjá. Lo oògùn apakòkòrò copper ní ìwọ̀n tí a kọ sí ara àpò rẹ̀. Má ṣe gbin tòmátì tàbí pọ́tétò sí ilẹ̀ yìí ní ọdún tó ń bọ̀. Ìmọ̀ràn AI ni èyí, ó sì lè ṣàṣìṣe. Jẹ́rìí sí i lọ́dọ̀ òṣìṣẹ́ àgbẹ̀ tàbí dókítà ẹranko kí o tó lo kẹ́míkà tàbí oògùn.

Akwụkwọ osisi ndị ahụ nwere ntụpọ gbara ọchịchịrị dị ka mmiri mikpuru ha. E nwere ihe ọcha dị nro n'okpuru akwụkwọ ndị ahụ. Ụfọdụ osisi nwere akara aja aja dị nso n'akwụkwọ. Nke a dị ka ọrịa late blight, ọrịa na-agbasa ngwa ngwa n'oge oyi na mmiri ozuzo. Ọ nwere ike imebi ugbo niile n'ime ụbọchị ole na ole ma ọ bụrụ na a chịkwaghị ya. Wepụ akwụkwọ ndị butere ọrịa ma kpọọ ha ọkụ taa. Agbala mmiri n'elu osisi; gbaa mmiri n'ala kama. Hapụ ohere n'etiti osisi ka ikuku na-agafe. Jiri ọgwụ fungicide nwere copper dịka ọnụọgụ edere n'akpa ya. Akụla tomato ma ọ bụ nduku n'ala a n'afọ na-abịa. Ndụmọdụ AI bụ nke a, ọ nwere ike ịdị njọ. Kwado ya na onye ọrụ ugbo ma ọ bụ dọkịta anụmanụ tupu ị jiri kemịkalụ ma ọ bụ ọgwụ.
